label: Services
intro: Building, training, consulting: intelligence embedded in the flow of work, not slideware.

stations.title: Scoped in a call. Prototyped in days. Shipped with evals.
stations.body: A short call fixes the problem, the data and the done-condition. A working prototype lands within days, not a deck. The shipped build comes with an eval suite, documentation and a handover, so it keeps working after he leaves. Strategic foresight meets execution: today's AI trends, translated into tomorrow's edge for your business.

stations.title: The stack he reaches for, and has shipped with.
stations.body: Python, PyTorch, LangChain and LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, FastAPI and FastMCP; Unsloth, TRL, vLLM, Ollama and llama.cpp; FAISS and Redis; AWS (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, Bedrock), Azure AI Foundry, Docker.

stations.title: Published, awarded, and still studying.
stations.body: B.E. Electronics and Communication, B.M.S. College of Engineering (2023). LLM fine-tuning (DeepLearning.AI), Generative AI fundamentals (Databricks), NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute. Best Team Award at Simplilearn; papers in Elsevier, Springer and Inderscience.

stations.title: Real solutions, not buzzwords.
stations.body: Every project embeds intelligence into a workflow: operational change, backed by metrics, from near-clinical-grade accuracy in healthcare to agentic workflows that cut a ten-day process to one. Let's turn today's AI breakthroughs into your next business differentiator.
